cost_basis.provenance: PyPSA v1.4.0 scigrid-de example uses illustrative per-carrier marginal costs; the upstream scigrid-lopf-then-pf notebook says these are not accurate.
assumptions: Example costs are placeholders, not market prices or a verified currency basis.
Only runs on this same example cost basis are monetarily comparable.
VOLL is a scenario penalty in illustrative cost units/MWh, not an economic outage-damage estimate.

name: SciGRID Germany (PyPSA example)
description: German 220/380 kV transmission grid from SciGRID v0.2 (derived from OpenStreetMap), with power plants, load and renewable availability for 24 hourly snapshots of 2011-01-01, as packaged by the PyPSA project (pypsa.examples.scigrid_de).

license.attribution: SciGRID Germany example network, (c) PyPSA Contributors (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA); grid topology from SciGRID v0.2 (DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems, formerly NEXT ENERGY, www.scigrid.de) based on OpenStreetMap data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0.

coverage.geographic: Germany, 220 kV and 380 kV transmission level (SciGRID v0.2, OSM-derived); lon/lat EPSG:4326.

missing_value_policy: Values the source does not provide are null in canonical.json and are never invented. PyPSA component defaults that would masquerade as data (e.g. line length 0) are emitted as null and listed in canonical.json assumptions. NaN/inf never appear in JSON. network.nc keeps PyPSA defaults because PyPSA requires finite values; flagged substitutions are listed in quality_flags.

transformations.description: Downloaded https://data.pypsa.org/networks/examples/v1.4.0/scigrid_de.nc (the URL pypsa.examples uses for v1.4.0); sha256 pinned in source/retrieval.json. network.nc is byte-identical upstream.
Converted to canonical-grid/1.0; derived impedances via calculate_dependent_values; defaults masquerading as data emitted as null.
